These facilities... consist of a collection system, pumping stations, force main, comminutor, three clay-lined aerated lagoons for secondary treatment and two effluent percolation ponds.
The two percolation ponds are approximately three-acres in size and are used year-round. The percolation ponds are designed to accommodate up to 0.32 mgd of treated effluent disposal.
